observation: Source-owned symbols existed in the model but were absent from a requested renderer.
cause: Record coverage was mistaken for visible consumer coverage, and native fragments can be lost by a second dash pattern.
proposed_rule: Check required enabled coverage separately for each requested consumer against an independent source inventory. Preserve native dash fragments without redashing; test missing, reversed and wrong-owner fragments in actual exports. Interactive hiding does not remove static elevation requirements.
limits: Instruction update; dated rendering evidence is not a fresh PDF source audit or customer acceptance.
